description: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) is the world’s largest independent Coca-Cola bottler. A global business and one of the leading consumer goods companies in the world. They help 1.75 million customers grow , and are constantly investing in exciting new products, innovative technologies and fresh ideas. This helps them delight the 600 million people who enjoy their drinks every day. In Great Britain, it employs some 3,600 people across England, Scotland and Wales at manufacturing sites, offices and depots. CCEP GB makes and distributes soft drinks for every occasion and sells more than four billion bottles and cans every year. There are eight manufacturing sites and offices in GB, supporting 8,500 suppliers with approximately 300,000 outlets selling its drinks. CCEP are successful because they are passionate , hard-working , and committed to their products, customers and each other. CCEP is a place where people can grow, be happy and be well in a safe, open, and inclusive workplace . At CCEP our graduate programme is designed to support and build our next generation of leaders by attracting and developing diverse candidates from across GB.
